wording_verbatim: Do you use Generative AI for your job? (Preceded by module definition: "Generative AI is a type of artificial intelligence that creates text, images, audio, or video in response to prompts. Some examples of Generative AI include ChatGPT, Gemini, and Midjourney.")
base_population: Employed US adults 18–64 in the Real-Time Population Survey (online panel weighted to CPS/ACS benchmarks); genAI module gated by an awareness screener (module skipped by the ~25.5% who had not heard of genAI)
response_options: Yes / No
break_note: Pilot Jun 2024; full module from Aug 2024. Authors' Oct 2025 revision: an Aug 2025 question-sequencing test showed earlier waves underestimated usage; a reweighting adjustment was applied to the 2024 and Feb/May 2025 waves (Aug 2024 overall: 39.4% initial -> 44.6% revised; see updated working paper appendix A.2.1 via the Fed post). Wave calendar per the same post: quarterly since Aug 2024 (pilot Jun 2024), i.e. Aug/Nov 2024, Feb/May/Aug/Nov 2025, Feb/May 2026.
